entries: **The panel's top-right button is now "⚙ Settings".** It opened the whole app menu but was labeled "Switch Panel"; Switch Panel is still in the menu.

**The status line switch moved into the Settings menu.** The "Terminal" button next to Today and Report turned off the status line that feeds the Claude quota, one mis-click away from the range buttons. It is now **Settings → Claude Code → Sync quota via status line** on macOS and Windows, with a tooltip that says what turning it off does. The Projects card keeps Today and Report, in two equal columns in every theme.

**Quota colors stay quiet until a quota is nearly used up.** Percentages and bars no longer turn yellow at 50%; only 80% and above turns red. The default panel shows percentages in the plain text color and keeps each tool's color on its bar, so a low Claude percentage no longer looks like a warning.
**Quota percentages are whole numbers.** Antigravity showed `70.6%` next to whole-number cards. Values round down, so 99.7% never reads as an exhausted 100%.
**The Today / Yesterday total matches the project rows.** Its tokens use the same large green numbers with the cost beside them, in every theme.

**The default panel is cleaner.** A smaller Settings button, Today as the lead button and Report as the quiet one, a centered divider between Session and Weekly, muted labels, thinner bars with a visible 80% mark, aligned project numbers, and status chips that no longer look like buttons.
**Light mode in the default panel is readable again.** Refresh Now and the top project's rank used white text on a light background; white app icons now have an outline on white cards.
**The Windows Muse quota check no longer flashes a console window.**

entries: **Muse Code has a quota card.** It shows Muse's 5-hour Session and weekly quota with reset countdowns in all 15 quota themes, with a menu bar item, a hide toggle, and the same near-limit, used-up and restored notifications as Antigravity. Muse keeps no quota file, so `usage` asks Muse itself with one small background request, without a session log and from an empty folder. It checks once when there is no reading yet, then only when the reading is over 30 minutes old and you have used Muse since. Each check uses a little of your Muse quota. A failed check waits for new Muse activity before trying again. Hiding the Muse card stops the checks, and the card hides itself when Muse isn't installed.

**Muse quota shows up wherever the other quotas do.** The Claude Code side pane, `usage status --json`, the multi-agent CLI dashboard, Quota-Aware Mode, and the Windows tray (card, tooltip, hide toggle, and notifications) now include Muse. They only read the last saved reading and never start a Muse check.

**Four or more quota cards switch to a compact layout.** Four full cards no longer fit on a laptop screen, so every quota card shrinks: a smaller header, Session and weekly side by side, and shorter percent and reset text. The Projects title shrinks to match. Three or fewer cards look the same as before.

**The menu bar shows at most three tools.** With Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and Muse all on, the strip got too wide and could slide behind the notch. It now keeps the three with the highest Session usage, in the usual order. The panel still shows every card.

**Stale-data warnings are readable in the Windows 95 and Cloud Observation themes.** The red warning sat directly on the Windows 95 blue title bar, and the pale amber one on Cloud Observation's sky-blue cards. Both now have enough contrast. In World Cup 2026, the English MATCH STATS heading is no longer cut off by the buttons next to it.

**Windows saves the quota card order again.** The tray accepted a new order only when it listed exactly the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards, so once the Grok card was in the panel, dragging cards into a new order was not saved. It now uses the same check as macOS.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session no longer runs your own hooks.** Its background `claude -p` and `codex exec` pings fired every hook you had set up, such as SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks, Codex's `hooks.json`, and the `notify` program in Codex's `config.toml`. A hook that sends a notification or saves the conversation ran once for every ping. Claude Code pings now load a settings file with `disableAllHooks`; Codex pings turn off `features.hooks` and `notify`. Antigravity pings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 有自己的額度卡了
title.en: Muse Code gets its own quota card

body.zh-TW: 你用 Muse 改完一份報告，想知道還能不能再跑一輪？現在點開 `usage` 面板就看得到 Muse 的額度卡：5 小時 Session（從開始用起算的 5 小時用量窗）和每週額度都有，附重置倒數，15 款額度佈景都能用。選單列多了 Muse 項目和隱藏開關，也有跟 Antigravity 一樣的快用完、已用完、已恢復通知。Muse 本機不留額度檔，所以 `usage` 會在背景送一次很小的請求直接問 Muse，不留對話紀錄，而且從空資料夾執行。⟦跟打電話問銀行餘額一樣，每通都要花錢，所以它不會一直打：還沒有讀數時問一次，之後要等讀數超過 30 分鐘、你又用過 Muse 才再問。⟧每問一次會用掉一點 Muse 額度；查詢失敗就等你再用 Muse 才重試。把 Muse 卡片藏起來就完全不查，沒裝 Muse 時卡片會自己隱藏。
body.en: Anyone juggling several AI coding tools dreads finding out mid-task that one of them has run dry. Say you just used Muse to revise a report and wonder whether there is room for another pass: open the `usage` panel and the Muse quota card is there, with the 5-hour Session (the usage window counted from when you start) and the weekly quota, reset countdowns, and support in all 15 quota themes. The menu bar gains a Muse item and a hide toggle, plus the same near-limit, used-up and restored notifications as Antigravity. Muse keeps no quota file on your machine, so `usage` asks Muse directly with one small background request, saving no conversation log and running from an empty folder. ⟦Phoning the bank for your balance costs a little each time, so you would not call every minute: it asks once when there is no reading yet, then only after the reading is over 30 minutes old and you have used Muse since.⟧ Each check uses a little of your Muse quota, and a failed check waits for new Muse activity before retrying. Hiding the Muse card stops the checks, and the card hides itself when Muse is not installed.

title.zh-TW: 側邊面板、終端機儀表板和 Windows 系統匣也看得到 Muse 額度
title.en: Muse quota appears in the side pane, terminal dashboard and Windows tray

body.zh-TW: 你在 Claude Code 裡寫到一半，想順便瞄一眼 Muse 還剩多少，不必再切回 `usage` 的主面板。Claude Code 側邊面板、`usage status --json` 指令、多工具終端機儀表板和額度感知模式，現在都列出 Muse。Windows 系統匣也一樣，卡片、滑鼠停留時的提示文字、隱藏開關和通知都加上了 Muse。⟦以前 Muse 的數字只擺在總店，現在各分店的櫥窗也擺上了，不過分店只陳列總店最後送來的那批貨，自己不會去進貨。⟧這些地方只讀最後一次存下的讀數，從來不會自己發起 Muse 查詢，所以多開幾個地方看，也不會多花你的 Muse 額度。

The Claude Code side pane, the `usage status --json` command, the multi-agent terminal dashboard and Quota-Aware Mode now all list Muse. The Windows tray does too, with Muse in its card, hover tooltip, hide toggle and notifications. ⟦Muse's numbers used to sit only in the flagship store; now every branch window displays them, but the branches only show the last batch the flagship sent over and never restock on their own.⟧ These places read only the last saved reading and never start a Muse check themselves, so looking in more places does not spend any extra Muse quota.

title.zh-TW: 兩款佈景的過期提示看清楚了，Windows 也記得住卡片排序
title.en: Stale-data warnings are readable in two themes, and Windows remembers card order

body.zh-TW: 換了花俏的佈景，有時反而看不到最該注意的提示。「視窗 95」佈景的紅色過期提示（提醒你數字太久沒更新）原本直接壓在藍色標題列上，「雲圖觀測」的淺橘提示壓在淺藍卡片上，現在兩者都有足夠對比；「世界盃 2026」英文版的 MATCH STATS 標題也不再被旁邊的按鈕擠掉。Windows 這邊，系統匣原本只接受剛好是 Claude 額度卡、Codex、Antigravity 三張卡的排序。⟦像衣帽間只認三號碼牌，多掛一件 Grok 外套就整排登記作廢；以前面板一有 Grok 卡，你拖好的順序就存不起來，現在改用跟 macOS 一樣的檢查，順序會記住。⟧
body.en: A flashy theme can end up hiding the one warning you most need to see. In the Windows 95 theme, the red stale-data warning (a reminder that the numbers have not updated in a while) sat right on the blue title bar, and in Cloud Observation the pale amber one sat on sky-blue cards; both now have enough contrast. In World Cup 2026, the English MATCH STATS heading is no longer cut off by the buttons beside it. title.zh-TW: 自動啟動 5 小時計時不再觸發你自己設的 hook
title.en: Auto-start 5-hour Session no longer fires your own hooks

body.zh-TW: 設過 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）的人，以前可能莫名收到一堆通知，或多出好幾筆存下的對話。原因是「自動啟動 5 小時計時」在背景執行 `claude -p` 和 `codex exec` 送出小請求，每次都會觸發你設的每個 hook，例如工作階段開始時跑的 SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、Stop hook，Codex 的 `hooks.json`，還有 Codex `config.toml` 裡的 `notify` 程式。⟦請鐘點清潔工來打掃，他每開一次門，門鈴、監視器通知和自動錄影就全響一輪；現在他改走不會觸動感應器的側門。⟧Claude Code 的背景請求改讀一份開了 `disableAllHooks` 的設定檔，Codex 的背景請求則關掉 `features.hooks` 與 `notify`。Antigravity 不變。
body.en: If you have set up hooks (small programs that run automatically at certain moments), you may have been getting a pile of unexplained notifications or extra saved conversations. The cause: Auto-start 5-hour Session sends small background pings through `claude -p` and `codex exec`, and every ping fired every hook you had set up, such as SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks, Codex's `hooks.json`, and the `notify` program in Codex's `config.toml`. ⟦Imagine hiring a cleaner who sets off your doorbell, camera alerts and auto-recording every time they open the front door; now they use a side door that trips no sensors.⟧ Claude Code pings now load a settings file with `disableAllHooks` turned on, and Codex pings turn off `features.hooks` and `notify`. Antigravity pings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版恢復 hook 安裝與更新
title.en: Windows Restores Hook Installation and Updates

body.zh-TW: 若你在 Windows 電腦上使用時，曾碰過切換設定後毫無動靜，現在各項開關都能正常生效了。⟦就像按下電燈開關，以前怎麼按都沒有反應，現在一按燈就亮了。⟧這項問題源自工具仰賴 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）來串接各項功能。從 v0.33.2 版起，Windows 打包時未將 hook 腳本放入安裝程式讀取的資料夾，導致安裝程式找不到檔案。連帶讓首次設定，以及接續對話、精簡模式與額度感知等開關在點擊後靜默沒有反應，原本已裝好的 hook 也停止更新。macOS 系統完全不受此問題影響。現在 Windows 版已恢復正常，能順利安裝並持續更新 hook。
body.en: If you previously experienced toggling settings on Windows with no response, all switches now take effect normally. ⟦Think of flipping a light switch: pressing it previously produced no reaction at all, but now the light turns on immediately.⟧ This issue stemmed from the tool relying on hooks (scripts triggered when specific events occur) to connect various features. Starting from v0.33.2, Windows packaging failed to include hook scripts in the folder read by the installer, leaving the installer unable to find the files. Consequently, initial setup as well as switches for continuing conversations, compact mode, and quota awareness silently failed to respond when clicked, and previously installed hooks also stopped updating. macOS is completely unaffected by this issue. Windows has now returned to normal, smoothly installing and continuously updating hooks.

entries: **The Antigravity card can switch to the Gemini 4 Argon quota.** The group toggle now cycles Gemini → Claude / GPT → Argon. Argon has a weekly limit only, so its 5-hour row says so. The Claude Code side pane and the Antigravity status line leave Argon out.

**Report rows show their share as a faint tint across the row.** The thin bars along each row's bottom edge read as crooked underlines; rows now fill with the tool's color up to their share, with spacing instead of separator lines.

**Antigravity shows its Gemini weekly quota again.** Google's quota API stopped reporting it, so usage now asks the Antigravity CLI itself (`agy -p /usage`, which makes no model call) and falls back to the API when the CLI is unavailable.

**The quota reminder no longer makes Claude think Antigravity is used up.** Each line names the tool and models it limits, a spent Antigravity group is followed by the groups that still have quota, and the reminder ends with Claude Code's own usage.
**Grok usage has an API-equivalent value again.** Grok models now match their xAI price entries instead of counting as $0.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 卡片支援切換至 Argon 額度

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度顯示修復，不再漏看週額度或誤判耗盡

body.zh-TW:

In the past, exhausting a single quota easily led Claude to assume Antigravity was entirely out of commission; now, every reminder line specifies the constrained tool and model group, immediately followed by groups that still have remaining quota, with Claude Code's own usage appended at the end.

title.en: Usage Report Inconsistencies Fixed to Align Cost and Label Definitions

body.zh-TW:

Browsing long-term statistics, you might have been startled by suddenly spiking percentages or unexplained amounts. ⟦Like a reconciled household ledger where an unexplained surge in expenses once caused confusion, every outgoing cost now notes its calculation method and comparison timeframe, keeping the accounts completely transparent.⟧

Converted amounts are consistently labeled throughout the page as “API equivalent” to eliminate confusing naming. Past Grok models were always calculated as zero dollars, but they now properly match official xAI pricing to calculate equivalent amounts, and Wrapped statistics specifically note which dates have pricing records.

Report calculation logic now includes comprehensive explanations. Weekly summaries state clearly which two complete weeks are being compared, preventing partial initial weeks of fewer than seven days from producing bizarre figures like a 980% surge. Switching to the “All” timeframe adds a note that earlier periods only record daily totals. Module labels have also been clarified, specifying the task ledger column as a percentage of weekly quota and explicitly sorting rankings by tokens (text units used for AI processing and billing).

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 恢復顯示 Gemini 額度，週額度用盡改標暫停
title.en: Antigravity Restores Gemini Quota Display and Labels It Paused When Weekly Quota Runs Out

body.zh-TW: 當你打開終端機準備趕工，卻擔心用量超標時，現在不必再對著空白面板瞎猜了。⟦好比運動中心的計時卡，以前週額度用完時，當天的五小時欄位還顯示全滿；現在不僅能從清單找回剩餘額度，總量用盡時也會改標為暫停。⟧先前 Google 的額度摘要不再回傳 Gemini 群組，讓 Antigravity 一度看不到用量。現在 usage 改從模型清單直接讀取 Gemini 的 5 小時額度。由於 Google 目前未回報週額度，卡片上會清楚標明未回報。只要應用程式開著，Antigravity CLI 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）也會同步顯示這組數字。一旦週額度用盡，Google 會在此時暫停 5 小時限額。過去該列會顯示「0% 已用／額度全滿」，容易讓人誤以為還能用；現在 5 小時那一列會直接改標為「暫停」，避免誤判。
body.en: When you open your terminal to work under a deadline and worry about exceeding usage, you no longer have to guess against a blank panel. ⟦Think of a sports center pass: in the past, when the weekly quota ran out, the day's five-hour slot still showed completely full; now it not only retrieves the remaining quota from the list, but also marks it as paused once the total is exhausted.⟧ Previously, Google's quota summary stopped returning the Gemini group, leaving Antigravity temporarily unable to see usage. Now usage reads Gemini's 5-hour quota directly from the model list instead. Because Google does not currently report weekly quota, the card clearly marks it as unreported. As long as the application is running, the Antigravity CLI status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) also displays these numbers in sync. Once the weekly quota is exhausted, Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point. In the past, that row displayed "0% used / Quota full", easily misleading users into thinking it was still usable; now the 5-hour row is directly labeled "Paused" to avoid misjudgment.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 僅剩單一額度分組時，切換按鈕現在會確實收起
title.en: Antigravity Now Properly Hides the Toggle Button When Only a Single Quota Group Remains

body.zh-TW: 平時點開選單列面板關心用量時，要是 Google 傳回的額度資料只有一個模型分組，介面就不會再擺出派不上用場的切換按鈕。⟦跟雙卡手機只插一張 SIM 卡時不會跳出切換門號的按鈕一樣，以前面板在無處可切換時仍留著一顆按了毫無反應的按鈕，現在只要沒有第二個選項，介面就會自動收起無效開關。⟧前一個版本原本就打算在額度回應只有一組時藏起切換鈕，但當時改動漏掉了應用程式實際載入的面板程式，導致每個面板依舊擺著無用的切換鍵。現在這個問題已經修好，不會再看到空轉的按鈕。日後等到 Gemini 分組額度重新出現，切換按鈕在下次重新整理時就會再次顯示，並繼續沿用你先前儲存的選擇。
body.en: When checking usage by opening the menu bar popover, if the quota data returned by Google contains only one model group, the interface no longer displays a useless toggle button. ⟦Just as a dual-SIM phone does not display a carrier-switching button when only a single SIM card is inserted, the popover previously kept a button that did nothing when clicked with nowhere to switch, but now the interface automatically tucks away the inactive switch whenever there is no second option.⟧ A previous release originally intended to hide the toggle button when the quota response contained only one group, but that change missed the popover script actually loaded by the application, leaving every popover still showing the unused toggle key. This issue has now been resolved, so you will no longer see an idling button. Once the Gemini group quota reappears in the future, the toggle button will show up again on the next refresh, continuing to honor your previously saved selection.

When the Gemini group comes back, the toggle reappears on the next refresh and your saved choice applies again.

entries: **The usage report explains its numbers instead of leaving units to guess.** Token composition and cache hit rate now sit in a visible section after tools rather than the collapsed appendix. The daily chart labels the peak's date, marks month starts and uses rounder axis steps; weekly rows show their date range; project hotspots add a share column and an "Other projects" row; the dispatch ledger and persona peak state what their numbers count.

**Reports keep usage older than 30 days even if you rarely open them.** Claude Code deletes transcripts after 30 days by default, and usage only saved its long-term history when a report was built. The menu bar and Windows tray apps now save the last 45 days every 6 hours in the background, and reports fill days missing from transcripts from that saved history. Filled days count toward totals, trends, tools and projects, but not sessions, token composition or cache hit rate. When moving to a new computer, copy `~/.usage/` as well.

**The Antigravity group toggle no longer stops working.** When one quota response skipped a model group, the card had nothing to switch to for five minutes. A group seen in the last 30 minutes is now kept. When the quota really has only one group, every panel and the Windows tray hide the toggle, and your group choice is kept for when both return.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表標明計算單位，圖表與專案占比直接攤開
title.en: Usage Reports State Measurement Units, Laying Out Charts and Project Shares

body.zh-TW: 每當你需要從用量報表掌握開發開銷，最怕遇上一整排沒有單位的孤立數字。⟦就像收到條理分明的信用卡帳單，以前明細總塞在背面折頁，現在各類款項標註清楚，連走勢圖表都幫你整理妥當。⟧現在 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成移出了收合附錄，直接排在工具段落後面。旁邊一併顯示快取（暫存算過結果直接調用的技術）命中率，不必再展開附錄查找。每日圖表清楚標出用量最高峰的日期與每月第一天，座標刻度的間距也改用更整齊的數值；每週資料列會列出日期區間，專案熱點則補上占比欄位與「其他專案」列。派工帳本與使用習慣高峰的數字，現在都會寫明到底算的是什麼。
body.en: Whenever you need to track development spending from a usage report, isolated numbers lacking units can be frustrating. ⟦Picture receiving a well-organized credit card statement where details were once buried in a fold on the back, but now every charge is clearly labeled and trend charts are neatly arranged for you.⟧ Now token (units for AI processing and billing) breakdowns have moved out of the collapsed appendix and sit directly behind the tools section. title.zh-TW: 三十天前的用量自動留存，背景定期備份不再遺失
title.en: Usage Older Than 30 Days Is Automatically Retained, Backed Up Regularly in the Background

body.zh-TW: 平時如果很少主動產出用量報表，等到月底想回頭核對專案花銷，常會發現早期的數據已經被清理一空。⟦跟行車記錄器自動把舊畫面存進備份槽一樣，以前太久沒匯出資料，舊紀錄就會被清空；現在背景程式會定時封存，不再擔心足跡消失。⟧Claude Code 預設在 30 天後刪除對話紀錄，而 usage 以前只在產出報表時才儲存長期數據。現在選單列與 Windows 系統匣應用程式每 6 小時在背景儲存最近 45 天紀錄，報表缺少的日子會自動補回。補回的天數會算進總量、趨勢、工具和專案，但不計入工作階段數。由於細節已清理，這些天數不計算 token（AI 運算與計費的文字單位）組成。當時的快取（暫存計算成果直接取用的機制）命中率也不會列入。日後換電腦時，記得將 ~/.usage/ 資料夾一併搬移。
body.en: If you rarely generate usage reports, checking project spending at month's end often reveals that early data has already been purged. ⟦Just as a dashcam automatically archives older footage into a backup slot, old records once vanished if you went too long without exporting data; now a background program archives them on a schedule so past footprints never disappear.⟧ Claude Code deletes conversation history after 30 days by default, and usage previously saved long-term data only when generating reports. Now, the menu bar and Windows system tray apps save the last 45 days of records in the background every 6 hours, automatically filling in missing dates in reports. Backfilled days count toward totals, trends, tools, and projects, but do not count toward session totals. Because details have been purged, these backfilled days do not calculate token (units for AI processing and billing) composition. Cache (temporarily saved results reused directly) hit rates from that time are also excluded. When moving to a new computer in the future, remember to migrate the ~/.usage/ directory as well.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 暫存分組清單，切換按鈕不再無故失靈
title.en: Antigravity Caches Group Lists, Preventing Toggle Buttons from Randomly Failing

body.zh-TW: 在 Antigravity 裡切換不同模型分組時，偶爾會遇上按鈕完全點不動的窘境。⟦好比收訊微弱時查看電視節目表，以前只要其中一台訊號延遲，選台器就整排鎖死；現在會記住半小時內的頻道清單，不會因為短暫斷訊就卡住。⟧以前只要額度（quota，可用資源上限）資料漏掉了某個模型分組，卡片就會有整整 5 分鐘沒有選項可以切換。現在 30 分鐘內出現過的分組都會被保留在快取（暫存計算或查詢結果的機制）中，避免按鈕失靈。如果額度真的只剩下單一分組，所有面板與 Windows 系統匣都會自動收起切換按鈕。你先前選好的分組依然會被系統記住，一旦兩組模型重新回歸，就會立刻恢復切換。
body.en: When switching between model groups in Antigravity, you might occasionally encounter a frustrating issue where the button simply will not click. ⟦Watching television under weak reception once locked up the entire remote if a single channel lagged; now the tuner remembers the channel guide from the past half hour so brief dropouts never freeze controls.⟧ Previously, whenever quota (the limit on available resources) data missed a model group, the card was left without switching options for a full 5 minutes. Now, groups that appeared within the last 30 minutes are retained in cache (a mechanism to temporarily store computed or queried results) to prevent the button from failing. If quota truly drops to a single group, all popovers and the Windows system tray automatically hide the toggle button. Your previously selected group is still remembered by the system, and switching is immediately restored once both model groups return.

items.original: **The Antigravity group toggle no longer stops working.** When one quota response skipped a model group, the card had nothing to switch to for five minutes. A group seen in the last 30 minutes is now kept. When the quota really has only one group, every panel and the Windows tray hide the toggle, and your group choice is kept for when both return.

entries: **Windows tray-icon menus stay outside the taskbar.** Right-clicking the tray icon now uses the same taskbar-aware position and foreground owner as the quota label, preventing the taskbar from covering the menu. Left-click behavior is unchanged.

**Windows: hardened three native calls that may relate to crashes while the screen is locked (#202).** The tray icon is no longer redrawn by two threads at once, Windows handles are no longer cut to 32 bits, and the file watcher waits for a pending read to finish before closing it. The crash cause is not yet confirmed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣選單不再被工作列遮住
title.en: Windows System Tray Menu Is No Longer Blocked by the Taskbar

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦右下角想查看用量或調整功能時，常常點了右鍵卻發現彈出的選單被底下的工作列擋掉半截，想點的選項根本按不到。現在右鍵點擊系統匣（螢幕右下角常駐的小圖示區域）圖示時，選單會自動避開工作列。新版本改用與額度文字相同的工作列避讓位置及前景擁有者（讓選單正確取得焦點的視窗設定），把選單完整顯示在工作列外側，再也不會被壓在底下。至於平常習慣用滑鼠左鍵點擊的操作，則完全維持原樣不變。⟦就像在餐桌邊緣立起菜單立牌，以前底部總被旁邊高大的調味罐擋住，想看菜色還得把罐子挪開；現在立牌會自動往調味罐外側擺放，所有品項完整呈現在眼前。⟧
body.en: When checking usage or adjusting features in the bottom-right corner of a Windows screen, right-clicking often opened a menu that was halfway blocked by the taskbar underneath, making the desired options impossible to click. Now, right-clicking the system tray (the notification area with persistent icons in the lower-right corner) opens a menu that automatically avoids the taskbar. The new version applies the same taskbar avoidance positioning and foreground owner (the window setting that lets menus take proper focus) used for quota text, displaying the menu entirely outside the taskbar so it is never trapped underneath. Usual left-click operations remain completely unchanged. ⟦Think of placing a tabletop menu card near the edge of a dining table: previously, the bottom was always blocked by a tall seasoning jar next to it, forcing you to move the jar aside to read the dishes; now the card automatically sits outside the seasoning jar, keeping every item fully in view.⟧

items.original: **Windows tray-icon menus stay outside the taskbar.** Right-clicking the tray icon now uses the same taskbar-aware position and foreground owner as the quota label, preventing the taskbar from covering the menu. Left-click behavior is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 加固 Windows 底層呼叫，防範鎖螢幕閃退
title.en: Hardening Low-Level Windows Calls to Prevent Lock-Screen Crashes

body.zh-TW: 暫時離開座位並鎖定 Windows 螢幕，解鎖回來時，有時會發現背景運作的軟體莫名閃退。為排查這項問題，開發團隊強化了三處可能相關的底層原生呼叫（直接與作業系統溝通的指令）。現在系統匣圖示不再被兩條執行緒（程式內部平行處理工作的管道）同時重畫。Windows 控制代碼（系統辨認資源的識別代號）不再被截成三十二位元。檔案監看元件也會等待進行中的讀取結束才關閉。雖然閃退主因目前尚未確認，但已先排除了潛在衝突。⟦跟出遠門前整理行李一樣，以前總擔心隨身物品在路上遺失，現在即使尚未查明上次掉東西的確切地點，也會先拉好容易撞開的拉鍊、換掉過短的吊牌並等證件收妥才扣上暗袋；把容易疏漏的環節提前打點好，旅途中就少了一份擔憂。⟧
body.en: When stepping away from the desk and locking the Windows screen, returning and unlocking the machine sometimes revealed that software running in the background had crashed unexpectedly. To investigate this issue, the team hardened three potentially related native low-level calls (instructions that interact directly with the operating system). The system tray icon is no longer redrawn concurrently by two threads (internal pathways that process tasks in parallel). Windows handles (system identifiers used to recognize resources) are no longer truncated to thirty-two bits. The file watcher also waits for ongoing reads to complete before shutting down. Although the root cause of the crashes has not yet been confirmed, potential conflicts have been eliminated in advance. ⟦Much like packing luggage before a long trip, travelers previously worried about losing personal belongings on the road; now, even without confirming the exact spot where an item was lost before, you still zip up easily snagged zippers, replace tags that are too short, and wait until IDs are securely stowed before fastening the hidden pocket, taking care of vulnerable points early to leave one less concern during the journey.⟧

items.original: **Windows: hardened three native calls that may relate to crashes while the screen is locked (#202).** The tray icon is no longer redrawn by two threads at once, Windows handles are no longer cut to 32 bits, and the file watcher waits for a pending read to finish before closing it. The crash cause is not yet confirmed.

entries: **Windows: usage no longer leaves a WebView2 folder in %TEMP% after each abnormal exit.** Each crash, forced close or shutdown with Windows previously left about 2.5 MB behind. usage now reuses one dedicated folder under `~/.usage/webview`.

**Sonnet 5.5 cache reads in the offline price table cost $0.10 per million tokens.** The table, used only when the LiteLLM download fails, still charged $0.20, so offline Sonnet 5.5 spending was overstated.

**Session resume no longer hands over another open window's work.** With several Claude Code windows in one project, a new window picked up whichever session was written last, often a neighbour still running. Sessions another window has open and wrote to in the last 10 minutes are now skipped; a window you just closed is still handed over. Background-task notices, `!` shell runs and bare slash commands no longer show up as your recent requests.

**Beginner Mode's terms stay up while background agents work.** Since Claude Code 2.1.299, a subagent or teammate starting its own turn also signals a new turn, which cleared the terms above the prompt and dropped the ones still being picked. Only a new turn in the main conversation clears them now.

title.zh-TW: Windows 異常結束不再堆積暫存檔，固定重複使用單一資料夾
title.en: Abnormal Windows Exits No Longer Accumulate Temp Files, Reusing a Dedicated Folder

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上使用 usage 時，若遇到系統關機或程式無預警閃退，硬碟空間常會不知不覺被吃掉。以前每次當掉、強制關閉或隨 Windows 關機，都會在暫存目錄 `%TEMP%` 留下約 2.5 MB 的 WebView2（微軟讓桌面程式顯示網頁畫面的組件）資料夾。隨著閃退次數增加，這些殘留檔案就會越積越多。現在 usage 改為重複使用 `~/.usage/webview` 這一個專屬資料夾，就算異常結束也不會再塞爆暫存區。⟦如同使用健身房的固定置物櫃，以前每次臨時離開都換鎖霸占一個新櫃子，現在不管來幾次都共用同一個號碼櫃，儲物區不會再堆滿垃圾。⟧
body.en: When using usage on Windows, system shutdowns or unexpected crashes used to quietly eat up disk space. Previously, every crash, forced quit, or Windows shutdown left behind a WebView2 (Microsoft's component for rendering web content in desktop apps) folder of about 2.5 MB in the `%TEMP%` directory. As crashes piled up, these leftover files continued to accumulate. Now usage reuses a single dedicated `~/.usage/webview` folder, so abnormal exits will no longer fill up the temp directory. ⟦Think of having a fixed gym locker: leaving unexpectedly used to mean locking and occupying a new locker every time, but now you reuse the same numbered locker no matter how many times you come, so the storage area never piles up with clutter.⟧

items.original: **Windows: usage no longer leaves a WebView2 folder in %TEMP% after each abnormal exit.** Each crash, forced close or shutdown with Windows previously left about 2.5 MB behind. usage now reuses one dedicated folder under `~/.usage/webview`.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表修正 Sonnet 5.5 快取費率，花費不再高估
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Corrects Sonnet 5.5 Cache Rates, Preventing Cost Overestimation

body.zh-TW: 當 LiteLLM 價目表下載失敗時，你看到的 Sonnet 5.5 花費可能被高估。usage 平常會連線下載 LiteLLM 價目表，只有在下載失敗時才會啟用備用清單。但這張備援表過去仍記載舊費率，把 Sonnet 5.5 讀取快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）的費用算得太貴。現在這份離線價目表已經修正，讀取計價由每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）$0.20 改為 $0.10，不再把 Sonnet 5.5 的離線花費算高。⟦你拿舊型錄估算採購費用時，以前會因為上頭的單價太高，把預估總額算高；現在手邊的備用型錄更新了，就能按正確的單價估算費用。⟧
body.en: If downloading the LiteLLM pricing table fails, Sonnet 5.5 costs might be overestimated. usage normally connects to download the LiteLLM pricing table, activating the fallback list only when that download fails. However, this fallback table previously retained outdated rates, pricing Sonnet 5.5 cache reads too expensively. Now this offline price table has been corrected, updating read pricing from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens (the text units for AI processing and billing), so Sonnet 5.5 offline expenses are no longer overestimated. ⟦When estimating procurement costs from an old catalog, inflated unit prices previously made the projected total too high, but now that the backup catalog on hand is updated, expenses are calculated using the correct unit prices.⟧

items.original: **Sonnet 5.5 cache reads in the offline price table cost $0.10 per million tokens.** The table, used only when the LiteLLM download fails, still charged $0.20, so offline Sonnet 5.5 spending was overstated.

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 多視窗與背景代理不再干擾進度，輸入提示穩定保留
title.en: Claude Code Multi-Window and Background Agents No Longer Interfere with Progress, Keeping Input Hints Stable

body.zh-TW:
你在同專案開多個 Claude Code 視窗或呼叫背景代理時，現在各項操作不再彼此干擾。⟦跟在共用辦公室工作一樣，以前只要隔壁同事動筆或助理跑腿，櫃檯就把你正在選的便籤收走、甚至塞來隔壁的文件；現在分工清楚，不再錯拿進度。⟧

以前開啟新視窗進行進度交接，常會誤接隔壁仍在跑的對話；現在會跳過其他開著且 10 分鐘內有寫入的工作階段，剛關閉的視窗仍正常交接。背景任務完成通知、以 `!` 執行的指令與無參數斜線指令，也不再被當成最近需求。

自 Claude Code 2.1.299 起，背景子代理或隊友開始回合時會誤觸訊號，清空輸入框上方的新手模式名詞；現在只有主對話展開新回合才會清除，挑字不再被中途打斷。
body.en:
When opening multiple Claude Code windows or calling background agents in the same project, operations no longer interfere with one another. ⟦Like working in a shared office, whenever a neighboring colleague started writing or an assistant ran an errand, the front desk used to take away the sticky note you were choosing or even hand you paperwork from next door; now responsibilities are clearly divided, so progress is never mixed up.⟧

Previously, opening a new window for progress handoff often mistakenly attached to an ongoing conversation next door; now, sessions that remain open with writes within 10 minutes are skipped, while recently closed windows still hand off normally. Background task completion notifications, commands run with `!`, and slash commands without arguments are also no longer treated as recent requests.

Since Claude Code 2.1.299, when background subagents or teammates started a turn, they accidentally triggered a signal that cleared Beginner Mode terms above the input box; now, they are cleared only when the main conversation starts a new turn, so selecting words is no longer interrupted midway.

items.original:
**Session resume no longer hands over another open window's work.** With several Claude Code windows in one project, a new window picked up whichever session was written last, often a neighbour still running. Sessions another window has open and wrote to in the last 10 minutes are now skipped; a window you just closed is still handed over. Background-task notices, `!` shell runs and bare slash commands no longer show up as your recent requests.
**Beginner Mode's terms stay up while background agents work.** Since Claude Code 2.1.299, a subagent or teammate starting its own turn also signals a new turn, which cleared the terms above the prompt and dropped the ones still being picked. Only a new turn in the main conversation clears them now.

entries: **usage uses far less CPU while it sits in the menu bar.** With the panel closed, a refresh took about 1.2 s of CPU and could run three times a minute, about 6% CPU on average while you work. Incremental history scans no longer list every Muse session again for each changed file, Muse sessions are reparsed only when they change, and resolved Claude project names are cached. A steady-state refresh now takes about 0.13 s.

**Closing the panel frees the memory of panels you browsed.** Each panel you switched to kept its own WebKit process after the panel closed, up to six and about 400 MB. Now only the current panel stays loaded once the panel closes. Switching while it is open is unchanged.

**Claude Desktop quota remains available when plan history stops updating.** A fresh local HTTP quota response for the latest history organization can now supply percentages and reset times even after the history sample expires. Expired responses, invalid organizations and another account's cache still return no data.
**The panel's right-click menu no longer offers Reload.** The v0.22.5 fix looked up the wrong menu item property, so right-click > Reload still blanked the panel (#42).

**Claude Haiku 5.5 has prices and a short name.** Its cost no longer drops out when the online price table is unreachable, and reports show "Haiku 5.5" instead of the raw model ID. The Auto-start 5-hour Session tooltip and dialog now name Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.
**Claude Desktop quota finds responses in Chromium's follow-on cache files.** Once the cache outgrew its first entry file, a fresh quota response could sit in a follow-on file and be missed.

**A Claude log that cannot be read is retried on the next refresh.** A brief lock, for example an antivirus scan on Windows, used to leave that file's usage missing until the file changed or usage restarted.
**Codex usage after a mid-session model switch is priced with the model that ran it.** Earlier turns were priced as the session's latest model. Codex history is reparsed once after this update.

title.zh-TW: 選單列常駐更輕巧，減輕處理器與記憶體負擔
title.en: Menu bar footprint is lighter, easing CPU and memory load

body.zh-TW: 長時間開著電腦工作，常駐在選單列的工具往往在不知不覺中吃掉大把電力與運算效能。⟦如同請了一位細心管家，以前客廳沒人也每分鐘全屋清點三次，離開房間還開著每盞燈；現在物品變動才核對，走出房門隨手關燈。⟧以前面板關閉時，每次刷新要花約 1.2 秒處理器時間，一分鐘可跑三次，工作時平均吃掉約 6% 運算效能。現在增量掃描不再因個別檔案變動就重列所有 Muse 工作階段，工作階段有變才重新解析，並把查好的 Claude 專案名稱放進快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用），穩定狀態下刷新只要約 0.13 秒。關閉面板後，以前切換過的面板會各自殘留 WebKit 程序，最多達六個且佔用約 400 MB 記憶體；現在關閉後只保留目前這款，開著時切換的體驗維持不變。
body.en: When working on a computer for long hours, tools residing in the menu bar often drain significant power and processing capacity unnoticed. ⟦Think of hiring a meticulous housekeeper: previously, even when the living room was empty, they did a full inventory three times a minute and left every light on after leaving a room; now, they only check inventory when items change and turn off lights upon leaving.⟧ Previously, when the popover was closed, each refresh consumed about 1.2 seconds of CPU time and could run three times a minute, taking up an average of about 6% of compute capacity during work. Now, incremental scanning no longer re-lists all Muse sessions whenever an individual file changes; it only re-parses when sessions change and caches retrieved Claude project names, reducing steady-state refresh time to about 0.13 seconds. After closing the popover, previously switched popovers each left behind WebKit processes, reaching up to six processes and consuming about 400 MB of memory; now only the current one is retained after closing, while the switching experience remains unchanged when open.

items.original:
**usage uses far less CPU while it sits in the menu bar.** With the panel closed, a refresh took about 1.2 s of CPU and could run three times a minute, about 6% CPU on average while you work. Incremental history scans no longer list every Muse session again for each changed file, Muse sessions are reparsed only when they change, and resolved Claude project names are cached. A steady-state refresh now takes about 0.13 s.
**Closing the panel frees the memory of panels you browsed.** Each panel you switched to kept its own WebKit process after the panel closed, up to six and about 400 MB. Now only the current panel stays loaded once the panel closes. Switching while it is open is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 額度穩定讀取，過期或被鎖檔不再缺漏
title.en: Claude Desktop quota reads reliably, no longer dropping when expired or locked

body.zh-TW: 現在追蹤 Claude Desktop 用量，不必再擔心額度數字莫名變空白或紀錄突然中斷。即使方案歷史紀錄已過期，只要最新歷史組織仍有新鮮的本機 HTTP 額度回應，就能繼續顯示百分比與重置時間；至於過期回應、無效組織以及其他帳號的快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用），則依然不會提供資料。當本機快取資料量超出第一個項目檔時，新的額度回應可能會被寫入 Chromium 的接續檔案，以前會因此漏掉，現在也能順利找到並讀取。遇到 Claude 紀錄檔短暫被鎖住時，例如 Windows 防毒軟體正在背景掃描，以前用量會一直缺漏直到檔案變更或重開軟體，現在會在下次刷新時自動重試讀取。以前你會卡在防毒軟體一掃描或快取一分卷就看不到額度、非得重開程式才能恢復，現在這些邊緣狀況都能自動銜接，讓你隨時看得到剩餘額度。
body.en: When tracking Claude Desktop usage, you no longer have to worry about quota numbers mysteriously turning blank or records suddenly dropping out. Even if plan history is expired, percentage and reset time continue to display as long as the latest historical organization still has fresh local HTTP quota responses; expired responses, invalid organizations, and caches from other accounts will still not provide data. When local cache data exceeds the first entry file, new quota responses may be written to Chromium continuation files; previously missed, they are now located and read smoothly. When Claude log files are temporarily locked, such as during background scans by Windows antivirus software, usage previously stayed missing until files changed or the app was restarted; it now automatically retries reading on the next refresh. Where you previously lost sight of your quota whenever antivirus scanned or the cache split into multiple volumes—forcing an app restart to recover—these edge cases are now handled seamlessly so your remaining quota stays visible.

items.original:
**Claude Desktop quota remains available when plan history stops updating.** A fresh local HTTP quota response for the latest history organization can now supply percentages and reset times even after the history sample expires. Expired responses, invalid organizations and another account's cache still return no data.
**Claude Desktop quota finds responses in Chromium's follow-on cache files.** Once the cache outgrew its first entry file, a fresh quota response could sit in a follow-on file and be missed.
**A Claude log that cannot be read is retried on the next refresh.** A brief lock, for example an antivirus scan on Windows, used to leave that file's usage missing until the file changed or usage restarted.

title.zh-TW: 模型計費回歸實際執行，報表名稱與定價不再漏失
title.en: Model billing reflects actual execution, keeping report names and pricing intact

body.zh-TW: 如果在 AI 費用明細裡看到一長串難懂的原始代碼，甚至換了模型卻被整筆高價計費，肯定讓人一頭霧水。⟦猶如請不同專長師傅接力修繕，以前只要後半段換了資深師傅，前半段學徒做的一律全照資深工資收費；現在每一段工時都按實際動手的師傅計價，帳單上也直接印出清楚簡稱。⟧當你在 Codex 對話中途切換模型時，用量現在會依照實際執行的模型分別計價；以前較早的回合會全部照該工作階段（session，一段持續對話的互動歷程）最後使用的模型來算，這次更新後會重新解析一次 Codex 歷史紀錄以修正帳目。Claude Haiku 5.5 也有了專屬定價與簡稱，連不上線上價目表時費用不會再消失，報表也會直接顯示簡稱而非原始模型 ID。而自動啟動 5 小時計時的提示與對話框，針對 Antigravity 也已正確改標為 Gemini 3.8 Flash Low。
body.en: Seeing cryptic raw IDs on an AI expense breakdown—or being billed entirely at higher rates after switching models—is bound to cause confusion. ⟦Picture specialized craftspeople taking turns on a renovation: previously, switching to a senior specialist midway meant earlier work by an apprentice was billed entirely at senior rates; now, each segment of labor is priced by who actually performed the work, and invoices clearly print clean short names.⟧ When you switch models mid-conversation in Codex, usage is now priced separately according to the model that actually ran. Earlier turns were previously billed entirely under the session's final model, but this update re-parses Codex history to correct the records. Claude Haiku 5.5 now has dedicated pricing and a short name; costs no longer disappear when offline from online pricing tables, and reports display its short name instead of the raw model ID. Additionally, prompts and dialogs that auto-start a 5-hour timer are now correctly relabeled as Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.

items.original:
**Claude Haiku 5.5 has prices and a short name.** Its cost no longer drops out when the online price table is unreachable, and reports show "Haiku 5.5" instead of the raw model ID. The Auto-start 5-hour Session tooltip and dialog now name Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.
**Codex usage after a mid-session model switch is priced with the model that ran it.** Earlier turns were priced as the session's latest model. Codex history is reparsed once after this update.

title.zh-TW: 面板右鍵選單移除重新載入，不再讓面板變空白
title.en: Reload removed from popover context menu, preventing blank screens

body.zh-TW: 許多人習慣在小工具畫面上按右鍵重新整理，以前這個動作卻可能讓面板變成一片空白。⟦就像遙控器上留了一顆容易誤觸的工程按鍵，以前隨手碰到會讓電視畫面變成一片空白，現在直接拆掉那顆按鈕，怎麼按都不怕出問題。⟧先前 v0.22.5 雖然曾嘗試修正這項問題，卻因為查錯了選單項目的屬性，導致你在面板上點擊滑鼠右鍵選擇『重新載入』時，依然會讓整個面板變成空白畫面。右鍵選單裡的『重新載入』已移除，這個問題已經修好。
body.en: Many users are used to right-clicking on widget screens to refresh, but this action previously risked turning the popover completely blank. ⟦Consider an easily bumped engineering button left on a remote control: previously, an accidental touch turned the TV screen blank, but removing that button entirely ensures nothing goes wrong no matter what you press.⟧ Although v0.22.5 previously attempted to address this issue, checking the wrong menu item property meant that right-clicking on the popover and selecting 'Reload' still caused the entire popover to become a blank screen. 'Reload' has now been removed from the context menu, fixing this issue.

items.original: **The panel's right-click menu no longer offers Reload.** The v0.22.5 fix looked up the wrong menu item property, so right-click > Reload still blanked the panel (#42).
